title: complex demo
code:
// complex demo — Main — 126 BPM, A minor / Fmaj7 / Cmaj7 / Gadd9
// Offline: original CC0 bd/sd/hh + built-in oscillators only.
stack(
  s("bd*4").gain(0.65),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").gain(0.3).room(0.12),
  s("hh*8").gain("[0.13 0.065]*4").swingBy(1/6,8).pan(0.35),
  s("hh").euclid(5,16).gain(0.05).speed(1.6).pan(0.7),
  s("sd").euclid(3,16).late(1/16).gain(0.045).lpf(2200),
  note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").struct("x ~ x [~ x]").s("triangle").decay(0.2).sustain(0.08).release(0.08).lpf(650).gain(0.27),
  note("<[a3,c4,e4,g4] [f3,a3,c4,e4] [c3,e3,g3,b3] [g3,b3,d4,a4]>").s("sawtooth").attack(0.12).decay(0.3).sustain(0.35).release(0.65).lpf(950).gain(0.075).room(0.32),
  note("<[a4 c5 e5 g5]*2 [f4 a4 c5 e5]*2 [c4 e4 g4 b4]*2 [g4 b4 d5 a5]*2>").s("sine").decay(0.09).sustain(0).release(0.12).gain(0.12).lpf(2400).delay(0.2).delaytime(0.2381).delayfeedback(0.25).room(0.18).pan("<0.25 0.75>"),
  note("<~ e5 [g5 e5] c5 ~ a4 [b4 d5] g4>").s("triangle").decay(0.18).sustain(0).release(0.22).gain(0.12).lpf(1800).delay(0.22).delaytime(0.3571).delayfeedback(0.3).room(0.25)
)
